title: Affine scalar Ext as associated dual Koszul homology
statement: Let $i:Z\to Y$ be a closed immersion of schemes [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-closed-immersion], $U$ an affine open of $Y$, and $A=\Gamma(Y,U)$. Write $I=i.\mathrm{ker}.\mathrm{ideal}(U)$ [def-sbc-closed-immersion-ideal-sheaf]. Let $n\in\mathbb N$ and $f:\mathrm{Fin}(n)\to A$ span $I$ and be Koszul-regular [def-weil-pbc-koszul-regular-sequence]. For an arbitrary supplied derived category universe on module sheaves of $Y$ [def-pc-derived-category], and every $q\in\mathbb Z$, set $F^q=H^q(R\mathcal Hom_Y(i_*\mathcal O_Z,\mathcal O_Y))$ [def-pur-derived-internal-hom]. Then the restriction $F^q|_U$, expressed as a module sheaf on the over-$U$ site, is isomorphic to the associated sheaf of $H^q(K_A(f)^\vee)$ [def-sc-koszul-dual-complex], transported along $U\simeq\operatorname{Spec}(A)$ and the over-site equivalence. Here $K_A(f)^\vee$ is the recorded integer-indexed signed dual Koszul complex. There is no rank function, point, or restriction on $q$, and no pullback occurs in this assertion.

source.place: Tag 0BQZ, proof of lemma-regular-immersion-ext, local finite free Hom computation; cohomology.tex Tag 08DM, Lemma 20.46.9

proof.text: The affine closed immersion identifies i^{-1}(U) with Spec(A/I) over Spec(A). The Koszul quotient augmentation is a quasi-isomorphism by regularity. Apply the affine quotient resolution sheafification lemma to its nonnegative chain form and extend to integer cochain degrees. Its terms are finite free exterior powers, zero above n; the extension gives zero positive cochain terms and a bounded finite free resolution of restricted i_*O_Z.

Restrict derived internal Hom to U. The bounded finite free Hom model into O_U in degree zero computes the resulting object. On standard opens, finite free coordinates identify sheaf Hom of a resolution term into O_U with the associated module Hom into A. Only the target degree-zero factor contributes to each total Hom degree. In degree k≥0 its differential is signed precomposition (-1)^(k+1) with the Koszul boundary, precisely koszulDualBoundary; negative-degree terms are zero. These coordinate identifications commute with localization, hence glue and give an isomorphism of complexes with the associated integer-indexed dual Koszul complex.

Associated sheafification is exact (its stalks are module localizations), so taking homology gives the associated sheaf of the module homology. Transport along the affine scheme isomorphism and the over-U module equivalence to obtain the displayed comparison. For the supplied derived universe, use the same K-injective resolution of the target in both that universe and the standard universe: derivedInternalHom_obj_iso identifies both cohomologies with the homology of the common Hom complex, so the comparison transports without assuming a derived category on U in the supplied universe. The empty sequence is the degree-zero structure sheaf and empty charts have the zero module category.

proof_origin.note: Source read at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/0BQZ; explicit coordinate and derived-universe glue expanded from the local Hom computation.

theorem affine_koszul_scalar_ext_comparison
    {Z Y : Scheme.{u}} (i : Z ⟶ Y) [IsClosedImmersion i]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
    (U : Y.affineOpens) (n : ℕ) (f : Fin n → Γ(Y, U.1))
    (hf : Ideal.span (Set.range f) = i.ker.ideal U)
    (hreg : RingTheory.Sequence.IsKoszulRegular f) (q : ℤ) :
    let F : Y.Modules := (DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)) q).obj
        ((derivedInternalHom (Opens.grothendieckTopology Y) Y.toRingedSpace.sheaf).obj
          (op ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
            (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)) 0).obj
              ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward i).obj (SheafOfModules.unit Z.ringCatSheaf))),
            (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
              (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)) 0).obj
                (SheafOfModules.unit Y.ringCatSheaf)))
    Nonempty (F.over U.1 ≅
      (Scheme.Modules.overEquiv U.1).inverse.obj
        ((tilde.functor Γ(Y, U.1) ⋙ Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.2.isoSpec.hom).obj
          ((ExteriorAlgebra.koszulDualCochainComplex (Γ(Y, U.1) : Type u) n f).homology q)))
